description: This is a Java test class for the CohortValidator component in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for validating Cohort objects, especially related to membership and patient status, using JUnit 5 and Spring validation frameworks.

classes.name: CohortValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of CohortValidator in different scenarios, including null inputs, patient voided state, and membership dates.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads data set, and prepares test objects before each test.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that the validator throws an exception when a null object is validated.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenInstanceOfOtherClassThanCohort
methods.description: Ensures the validator throws an exception if an object other than Cohort is validated.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsVoided
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when a patient in the cohort is marked as voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfPatientIsNonVoided
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when the patient is active (not voided).

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfMembershipisVoided
methods.description: Ensures validation passes if the cohort membership is marked as voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfPatientAndMembershipAreVoided
methods.description: Validation should pass if both patient and membership are voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfMembershipStartDateIsAfterEndDate
methods.description: Checks that validation passes when the membership start date is after the end date.
